summary.text: Jason Knight is a Democrat who has represented House District 67 (Barrington and Warren) since November 2016, serving as a Deputy Majority Leader since January 2021 and as first vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Knight served eight years in the U.S. Navy as an enlisted nuclear power operator, including teaching at the Naval Nuclear Power Prototype facility in Idaho and serving on the USS Albuquerque.

He received a Bachelor of Fine Arts from Emerson College and a J.D. from Suffolk Law School, and worked in the Rhode Island Department of the Attorney General as a special assistant attorney general from 2006 to 2010; he is now a self-employed attorney.

His biography lists sponsorship of a 2021 law banning straw purchases of firearms, a 2022 law eliminating court fees for many people, a law allowing more arrest records to be sealed after acquittal, and a 2025 law updating the state's explicit-image law to cover AI-generated deepfakes; it also notes he cosponsored the 2025 assault weapons sale ban.
He lives in Barrington with his wife Nicole; they have two children, and he was born October 28, 1969.
